import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Data Preprocessing
# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' values with 'None' for clearer categorization
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)
# Ensure BMI Category is ordered for better visualization
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [2, 1], 'height_ratios': [1, 1]})
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Sleep Health Analysis by Occupation', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by Occupation (Top-Left) ---
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Occupation',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=ax1,
    palette='tab20'
)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Occupation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# --- Plot 2: Distribution of Stress Levels by Sleep Disorder (Top-Right) ---
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Stress Level',
    ax=ax2,
    palette='plasma'
)
ax2.set_title('Stress Levels by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# --- Plot 3: Average Daily Steps by BMI Category and Gender (Bottom-Left) ---
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='Gender',
    ax=ax3,
    palette='magma',
    errorbar=None
)
ax3.set_title('Average Daily Steps by BMI Category', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(title='Gender')

# --- Plot 4: Heart Rate Distribution (Bottom-Right) ---
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.histplot(
    data=df,
    x='Heart Rate',
    kde=True,
    ax=ax4,
    color=sns.color_palette("viridis")[3]
)
ax4.set_title('Resting Heart Rate Distribution', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96]) # Adjust layout to make room for suptitle
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
